mapper.select:
SELECT t1.id, t1.unit_name, t1.unit_precision, t1.round_code, t1.state, t1.remark FROM bp_unit AS t1 WHERE t1.is_deleted = 0
and t1.unit_name like concat('%',#{unitName},'%')
ORDER BY t1.create_time DESC
mapper.delete: UPDATE bp_unit SET del_flag = id, is_deleted = 1, update_time = now(), update_by = #{userId} WHERE id = #{id}
